entries.head: pick up

senses.en: to collect someone in a car

example.en: Can you pick me up at Exit C? The taxi line is insane.
example.zh: 你能在 C 口接我吗？打车的队排得离谱。

senses.en: to collect something you ordered or left somewhere

example.en: I'll pick up the package at the front desk after work.
example.zh: 我下班后去前台取快递。

entries.l1_note: 代词必须夹在中间：pick me up。说 pick up me 是中文语序硬套。

entries.head: drop off

senses.en: to take someone or something to a place and leave them there

example.en: Just drop me off at the corner — I'll walk the rest.
example.zh: 在路口把我放下就行，剩下的路我走过去。

entries.l1_note: 和 pick up 是一对：pick up 是接，drop off 是送。别都翻成“拿”。

entries.head: check in

senses.en: to register for a flight and hand over your bags

example.en: You can check in online 24 hours before the flight.
example.zh: 起飞前 24 小时可以在线值机。

senses.en: to register at a hotel when you arrive

example.en: We checked in around ten and went straight to bed.
example.zh: 我们十点左右办了入住，直接睡了。

entries.l1_note: check in 不带宾语；带酒店名要说 check into the hotel。
collocations: check in at the front desk

entries.head: check out

senses.en: to pay and leave a hotel

example.en: We have to check out by noon, so let's eat breakfast early.
example.zh: 中午前要退房，我们早点吃早饭吧。

senses.en: to look at something because it might interest you

example.en: That new noodle place looks good — let's check it out.
example.zh: 那家新开的面馆看着不错，去试试。

entries.l1_note: “退房”不是 leave the room。前台只会问 What time are you checking out?

entries.head: check into

senses.en: to register and stay at a hotel

example.en: We checked into the hotel and crashed immediately.
example.zh: 我们办了入住，然后倒头就睡。

entries.l1_note: 入住某家酒店用 check into；check in 不带宾语。

entries.head: put up

senses.en: to let someone stay in your home for a while

example.en: My cousin put us up for two nights when we missed the last train.
example.zh: 我们错过末班车，表姐让我们在她家住了两晚。

entries.l1_note: “住朋友家”不是 live in my friend's home，短期借住是 put someone up。
collocations: put someone up for the night

entries.head: drop by

senses.en: to visit someone briefly, often without planning

example.en: I'll drop by your hotel around seven.
example.zh: 我七点左右顺路去你酒店一趟。

entries.l1_note: 顺路来一下；drop off 是放下人或物。

entries.head: get away

senses.en: to leave a place, especially when it is hard

example.en: I need to get away for a weekend — work is driving me crazy.
example.zh: 我得出去过个周末，工作快把我逼疯了。

entries.l1_note: 抽身或短途出游；get away from 是逃离。

entries.head: get back

senses.en: to return to a place

example.en: What time do you think we'll get back tonight?
example.zh: 你觉得我们今晚几点能回来？

senses.en: to reply to someone later

example.en: I'll get back to you by Friday.
example.zh: 我周五前回复你。

entries.l1_note: “回复你”不是 reply you（错），是 get back to you 或 reply to you。

entries.head: wait around

senses.en: to wait without doing anything useful

example.en: We waited around for an hour before the bus finally came.
example.zh: 我们干等了一个小时，公交才来。

entries.l1_note: 无所事事地等；wait for 是等具体的人或物。

entries.head: look out for

senses.en: to keep watching for something so you do not miss it

example.en: Look out for the green sign that says Arrivals.
example.zh: 留意写着“到达”的绿色牌子。

entries.l1_note: 留意找某物；watch out 是小心危险。

entries.head: take off

senses.en: when a plane leaves the ground

example.en: The plane took off two hours late because of the storm.
example.zh: 因为暴雨，飞机晚了两小时才起飞。

senses.en: to remove a piece of clothing

example.en: Take off your jacket — it's warm in here.
example.zh: 把外套脱了吧，里面挺暖和的。

entries.l1_note: 脱衣服是 take off，不是 put off；put off 是推迟。

entries.head: set out

senses.en: to start a journey

example.en: We set out at six to beat the traffic.
example.zh: 我们六点出发躲堵车。

entries.l1_note: 出发是 set out / set off；set out 更偏“踏上行程”。

entries.head: head off

senses.en: to leave in order to go somewhere

example.en: I should head off now or I'll miss the last train.
example.zh: 我得走了，不然赶不上末班车。

entries.l1_note: 先走一步是 head off；head for 是前往，方向感不同。

entries.head: check out of

senses.en: to leave a hotel after paying

example.en: We checked out of the hotel at noon and left our bags.
example.zh: 我们中午退房，把行李寄存了。

entries.l1_note: 退房是 check out of，带宾语；check out 单独是退房或去看。

entries.head: see off

senses.en: to go to a station or airport to say goodbye

example.en: My parents saw me off at the airport.
example.zh: 我爸妈到机场送我。

entries.l1_note: 送行是 see someone off，不是 send someone（那是寄送）。
collocations: see someone off at the airport

entries.head: come back

senses.en: to return to a place

example.en: What time are you coming back tonight?
example.zh: 你今晚几点回来？

entries.l1_note: 回来是 come back；回去是 go back，方向靠说话人。

entries.head: go back

senses.en: to return to a place you left

example.en: I left my charger at the hotel — I have to go back.
example.zh: 充电器落酒店了，我得回去一趟。

entries.l1_note: 回去是 go back（离开说话人所在地）；回来是 come back。

entries.head: stay over

senses.zh: 在别人家或酒店住一晚
senses.en: to sleep at a place for a night

example.en: Do you want to stay over? The last train is gone.
example.zh: 你要住一晚吗？末班车没了。

entries.l1_note: 过夜是 stay over；stay 单独是待着。

entries.head: send off

senses.en: to mail something

example.en: I sent off the documents this morning.
example.zh: 我今早把材料寄出去了。

entries.l1_note: 寄出是 send off；送行是 see off，别混。

entries.head: turn up

senses.en: to arrive somewhere, often unexpectedly

example.en: He turned up at the gate with no ticket.
example.zh: 他没票就出现在检票口。

entries.l1_note: 出现是 turn up / show up；不是 appear at（太书面）。

entries.head: stop off

senses.en: to visit a place briefly on the way

example.en: We stopped off at a service area for lunch.
example.zh: 我们中途在服务区停下来吃午饭。

entries.l1_note: 中途停是 stop off (at)；stop over 是过夜停留。

entries.head: stop by

senses.en: to visit a place briefly

example.en: Stop by the front desk on your way out.
example.zh: 出去的时候顺路去趟前台。

entries.l1_note: stop by 和 drop by 同义，美式都常用。

entries.head: come along

senses.en: to go somewhere with someone

example.en: Come along — we're leaving in five minutes.
example.zh: 一起来吧，五分钟后走。

entries.l1_note: 一起来是 come along；come with me 也很自然。

entries.head: bring along

senses.en: to take someone or something with you

example.en: Bring along your passport — they check at the gate.
example.zh: 带上护照，门口要查。

entries.l1_note: 带上是 bring along；带来是 bring over。

entries.head: pack up

senses.en: to put your things into bags

example.en: We packed up the room in twenty minutes.
example.zh: 我们二十分钟就把房间收拾好了。

entries.l1_note: 收行李是 pack up；pack 单独是装包。

entries.head: fly out

senses.en: to leave a place by plane

example.en: They fly out to Shanghai on Monday.
example.zh: 他们周一的飞机去上海。

entries.l1_note: 飞出去是 fly out；fly back 是飞回来。

entries.head: drive off

senses.en: to leave in a car

example.en: The taxi drove off before I could check the meter.
example.zh: 我还没看计价器，出租车就开走了。

entries.l1_note: 开走是 drive off；pull away 更强调从停靠处启动。

entries.head: look around

senses.en: to walk around and see what is there

example.en: We looked around the old town for an hour.
example.zh: 我们在老城逛了一小时。

entries.l1_note: 四处看看是 look around；look for 是找东西。

entries.head: show around

senses.en: to take someone on a tour of a place

example.en: My cousin showed us around the campus.
example.zh: 我表弟带我们逛了校园。

entries.l1_note: 带人参观是 show someone around，代词夹中间。
